t: This is 2 South Audley Street, a nineteenth-century terrace house in Mayfair. It was designed by two architects, George Aitchison and Frederick Pepys Cockerell. Aitchison was a British architect and Royal Academician, described as a man of considerable reputation. Cockerell was the second son of the architect Charles Robert Cockerell, whose liking for French architecture and for sculpture within buildings was a major influence on him. The house is a good example of the kind of Victorian terrace building that shapes this part of Mayfair.
